_comment: This is the rung the memorization-onset curve was first measured on, and the
settings here are the ones that produced the reported table, not a cleaned-up
version: per_cell 160, batch 6 with auto_batch ON, indistinguishable 12, 600
steps, fixed eval set of ~29 held-out instances.
k_set [0] with k0_rate 1.0 means NO in-context demonstrations. The rule is
memorizable in weights, so held-out accuracy here measures applying a known
map to new inputs. That is not generalization in the sense the research goal
means. Do not report a rule-INDUCTION result from this rung.
